Let me test the Django qgis-auth with credentials.

action.command:
CADDY_IP=$(docker inspect -f '{{range .NetworkSettings.Networks}}{{.IPAddress}}{{end}}' qonnectra_caddy_dev)
echo "=== qgis with basic auth ==="
docker run --rm --network qonnectra_network_dev curlimages/curl:latest -sk --resolve qgis.localhost:443:$CADDY_IP -u "admin:AdminLocalPassw0rd!" -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" "https://qgis.localhost/ows/?SERVICE=WMS&REQUEST=GetCapabilities&MAP=/projects/test-project.qgz"
echo "=== qgis-auth endpoint ==="
docker run --rm --network qonnectra_network_dev curlimages/curl:latest -sk --resolve qgis.localhost:443:$CADDY_IP -u "admin:AdminLocalPassw0rd!" -D - -o /dev/null "https://qgis.localhost/ows/?SERVICE=WMS&REQUEST=GetCapabilities" | grep -i "HTTP\|x-auth" | head
